title: STEP BY STEP GUIDE ON APPLICATION FOR AN ONTR or NTR REFUND - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
| ONTR (Ministries Departments Agencies) | A person claiming an ONTR Refund should attach the following: ·       Erroneous/Wrong/Expired PRN & Correct PRN ·       NIN for Individuals a must ·       Passport No/Refugee ID/Work Permit No (for Immigrations) ·       TIN/Business Registration Numbers for Companies ·       Bank Account number (for companies it should be under company name) ·       Account holder in the names of the applicant ·       Birth certificate for Minor & ID of parent (NIRA, Immigrations) ·       For Judiciary, attach court documents & confirmation letter from The Judiciary. ·       Letter of administration or meeting minutes in case of a deceased ·       Confirmation letter from the MDA |
| --- | --- |
| NTR | A person claiming an NTR Refund (Driving permit/Stamp Duty/Motor vehicle) should attach the following: For Driving Permits ·       Erroneous/Wrong PRN & Correct PRN ·       Valid driving license ·       NIN a must (include in the remarks box) ·       Mobile Number (a must) ·       Bank Account number ·       Account holder in the names of the applicant ·       Police Letter for duplicate permits For Motor vehicle ·       Erroneous/Wrong PRN & Correct PRN ·       Motor vehicle Number plate (capture in remarks) ·       TIN for companies and NIN a must for individuals (include in the remarks box) ·       Motor vehicle Transfer application reference number ·       Mobile Number (a must) ·       Account holder in the names of the applicant (for companies, in the name of the company) ·       Bank Account number For Stamp duty Refund ·       Stamp duty cancellation Notice with assessment number ·       Stamp duty certificate with a PRN ·       Mobile Number (a must) ·       Account holder in the names of the applicant ·       Bank Account number ·       Documents in relation to the transaction |
